_note: RidgeLine's identity fixture. One of: 'untrusted-issuer' (VC signed by a rogue issuer), 'unresolvable-did' (no DID document), 'revoked' (VC on the revocation list), or 'none' (fully valid — re-admits RidgeLine, proving the trust gate is cryptographic, not a name check). Re-run `pnpm identity:issue` after changing this.
